value.rationale: A dimension-independent sharp variation perturbation budget for a natural TV-constrained denoiser is nontrivial: Euclidean nonexpansivity does not give it, and one-input variation contraction hides the exact two-input instability. The first expansive dimension and extremizing local face are motivated stability features; the Green-interpolation mechanism also exposes the structural source of the bound.
